repository_sources: recent frontier, vercel, and continuity commits

finding: The verified OIDC receipt pipeline existed, but no single operations-only adapter constrained GitHub runner environment ingestion, exact-run expectation derivation, no-overwrite receipt persistence, and token-free output.
design_implication: Runner-provided repository, commit, run, attempt, and environment values now override any user-authored expected JSON identity fields; only audience, observation time, and transcript digests are read from the expected file. The raw request authorization and JWT remain process-memory inputs and are excluded from returned and persisted output.

covered_cases: runner identity precedence over expected JSON
in-memory authorization handoff with token-free result
verification.execution_limit: No authenticated checkout or GitHub Actions run was available in this tool path; tests are committed but not claimed as executed.

uncertainty: Live ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL and ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN behavior was not observed.
No workflow permission boundary was executed.
No retained receipt was produced from a real GitHub-hosted runner.
The adapter does not establish same-process integrity, hardware identity, deployment identity, or transcript-content truth.
falsification_route: Execute the committed tests in an authenticated checkout and reject on any failure.
Run an operations-only workflow with id-token: write and prove that missing permission fails closed.
Inspect retained output and reject if request authorization or JWT bytes appear.
Attempt expected-file identity substitution and reject if it can override runner repository, SHA, run, attempt, or runner environment.
Attempt a second write to the same output path and reject if overwrite succeeds.
privacy_boundary: No credentials, OIDC token values, private source material, or user-specific personal data are retained.
